player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} deg urar n Poker n Lhend.
- 52 takarḍa; tettwali kan takarḍa n umsenti.
- Ante {ante} ččuren(t) deg kray, {max_rounds} kray(t) deg wakud.
- Imurazen iγelnawen: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X d aseḍruṣer amḍan ≤ uṭṭun n ččuren inek.)
- Takarḍa tafukt tewwi-d laksur di tukkirt.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Sekcem yiwen aseɣwen amḥassen, s tɛɛl: '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', neɣ '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ur tezmiremt ara [check] - tettwaḥsabem s umata.
invalid_move.amount_min: Amḍan n umenɣi / usnerni ilaq ad yili ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Ur tezmir ara ad '[bet]' - ilaq ad '[call]' / '[raise]' / '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ulac d acu ara tessawleḍ; zemremt ad [check] deg umkan-is.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Seqdec [bet X] akken ad teldiḍ; ulac win ara d-yessers.
invalid_move.insufficient: Ur d-yusi ara uḥric n tbaqit i lmendad am wa.

message.showdown_tie: Tameɣra n usekles: i sin {card}. Tacekkart tefrar  yal yiwen yettawi {split} .
